# AnalogOS Chile · Final design decision (Explore / Mission redesign)

This document synthesizes the 8 proposals. The figures are verified against `artifacts/science-v2/candidate-details.json`, `artifacts/science-v2/analysis-summary.json` and `config/mission_profiles/mars-rover-screening-v2.json` (dev branch, 857b05f).

The 21st URLs are the ones cited by the proposals. Their public `.md` only provide metadata, because the code requires an API key. For that reason, patterns are adopted, not code.

> **Integration with dev (2026-11-14, ADR-013).** The interface described here (fixed stage, globe with
> switch to 2D, ●◆○, carousel, Tesla lines, rail, composer, Reading, “Honest orbit”, mobile sheet) is the
> current interface, now on top of the team's **v3 Chile–Argentina** scientific snapshot (ADR-008:
> Yungay is a known reference, “REF”, outside the ranking) and on its **planner** (ADR-009:
> confirmed requirements, `evaluateMission`, JSON export, Anthropic AI on the server only).
> The following are **superseded**: client-side recalculation by weights (ADR-015, formerly ADR-011 and ADR-009), the lktron channel
> and the contracts of §5 (ADR-012, formerly ADR-010), the predefined profiles, the “DEMO · no
> AI” match and the pregenerated prose. Mission no longer computes any %: it shows statuses, evaluation rankings,
> met preferences and the v3 similarity without recalculating. The integration details are in
> `docs/INTEGRATION_PLAN.md`; the affected sections carry a note.

---

## 0. Main decisions

1. **Fixed stage** (100dvh, no document scroll). The Earth always stays in the background and is rotated with one finger.
2. **One spatial rule for the whole site:**
   - center = where (globe and lines);
   - right = the place (metrics);
   - left = your mission and why (only from 1440 px);
   - bottom = choose and write, in a single dock.
3. **Below 1100 px there is a single sheet with 3 detents:** S0 tray, S1 place, S2 detail sheet. Sheets are not stacked.
4. **A single motion system** (6 curves, 6 durations, 2 staggered). Results choreography: globe → lines → rail → AI analysis. Data never waits for decorative animation.
5. **Loading WOW = “Honest orbit”.** The planet is the loader and only marks real milestones. The same orbit returns while the AI interprets.
6. **Color with fixed meaning.** Orange = Mars as data (Jezero). Selection = ice + blue. Error = neutral with ✕. Glyphs: ■ = Jezero, ◆ = emblematic analog.
7. **No loop lasts longer than 4,8 s.** No number is interpolated or counts up.
8. **The AI never produces figures or ranks.** *(After ADR-013: the team's AI only proposes unconfirmed requirements or selects IDs from the evaluation; the team's deterministic engine produces every figure, every ranking and every status.)*
9. **Mission works offline.** *(After ADR-013: manual requirements or “Use example”, local confirmation and deterministic evaluation; the AI is an optional enhancement with an explicit button. There are no longer predefined profiles, “DEMO · no AI” or pregenerated prose.)*
10. **0 new npm dependencies.** Budget: +≤12 KB gz in the main chunk, ≤2 KB gz inline in the HTML, the rest deferred.
11. **ADR** in `docs/decisions/` (renumbered upon integrating with dev, which already used ADR-008 and ADR-009):
    - ADR-014: fixed stage and sheet (formerly ADR-010 and ADR-008; proposed).
    - ADR-015: deterministic client-side recalculation for mission profiles (formerly ADR-011 and ADR-009; **superseded by the team's ADR-009**).
    - ADR-012: optional AI, outside the core flow (formerly ADR-010; **superseded by ADR-009 §7–9**).
    - ADR-013: integration of the redesign with the planner, the v3 data and the team's AI (proposed).
    - (proposal) MapLibre globe as the single engine, after the hackathon.

## 1. Contradictions between proposals and how they are resolved

| # | Conflict | Between | Resolution |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Does the chat go above or below the places carousel? | Globe, Carousel and Loading put it above; Bar, Layout and AI, below | A single glass dock: carousel on top and composer attached to the bottom edge (near the thumb and the keyboard). Results appear above what was typed. |
| 2 | Left column requested by three pieces: “Your mission” card, “AI Reading” panel and Tesla label column. In addition, Loading placed the profile and analysis on the right | Bar, AI, Tesla, Loading | From 1440 px: a left “Mission” panel with two sections. Between 1100 and 1439 px there is no left panel: “Your mission” is a composer popover and the Reading is a tab of the rail. Tesla labels choose the side with the most space within the safe area. |
| 3 | Eight different breakpoints (560, 760, 768, 900, 1024, 1100, 1280…) | All | Three ranges: ≥1440, 1100–1439 and <1100. With height <860 px, compact variants are used. The carousel density is adjusted with a container query. |
| 4 | Five different sheets on mobile | Layout, Carousel, Metrics, AI, Bar | A single sheet (S0/S1/S2). AI and Your mission are sections of S2. “View list” changes the sheet content instead of opening another one. |
| 5 | Tesla lines on mobile: up to 3 labels or a single line to the slot | Layout versus Tesla and Metrics | A single line. It ends at the top edge of the sheet, aligned with the active slot, and does not cross content. |
| 6 | When results arrive: fly to #1 or not move the camera? | Globe versus Loading | #1 stays in preview selection, without moving the focus. It only flies if the user did not touch the camera during the wait. If they did, the chip “Center on ‹#1›” appears. |
| 7 | Numbers that “roll” from the previous value to the new one | Metrics versus the rest | Interpolating figures is prohibited. A fade with a 4 px shift indicating whether it went up or down is used. Arcs and bars may transition. |
| 8 | Skeletons and loading ring in an infinite loop, against WCAG 2.2.2 | Carousel, Metrics, AI, Bar | Global rule: no loop exceeds 4,8 s. While waiting for the AI there is a single heartbeat (orbit + composer light, in phase). Skeletons are static. |
| 9 | Orange meant at once selection (current code and Globe), Jezero (Metrics and ScoreBreakdown) and error (Bar) | Several | Orange only for Mars as data, plus the logo accent. Selection = #EAF4FA ring + blue border. Error = neutral + ✕ + text. |
| 10 | ◆ meant emblematic analog and also Jezero | Globe and Carousel versus Metrics | ◆ = emblematic; ■ = Jezero. |
| 11 | “Limiting factor” (most negative contribution) versus “weakest point” (lowest similarity). With real data they do not coincide: in Yungay the limiting factor by contribution is Roughness (−0,091) and the lowest similarity is Relief (63 %) | Metrics versus AI | A single concept: **Limiting factor = `contribution` field of the pipeline.** The AI fact type changes from `weakest_in_site` to `limiting_factor`. |
| 12 | Pulses in four places (×3 on selection, landing halo, hover pulse, Tesla ring) | Globe, Loading, Carousel, Tesla | Landing: one halo. Selection: the place ring emits one pulse and stays static. Hover from the carousel: scale 1,2, without a pulse. |
| 13 | The carousel enters at the end of the WOW or as soon as the snapshot is validated | Carousel versus Loading | As soon as the snapshot is validated: it is the accessible route and real content is not delayed. |
| 14 | Dimming during the wait: 35, 40, 45, 50 or 60 %, with or without `inert` | Several | Token `--o-busy: .45` with `aria-busy` and without `inert`, so that the user keeps control. |
| 15 | When selecting a ◆: card over the globe, rail or dashed line | Globe, Metrics/Carousel, Tesla | Rail in compact state “World reference · to be computed”, with its source. No Tesla lines and with a dashed ring “approximate area”. |
| 16 | “Atacama Desert”: a badge over a ● or its own card “contains the 3 sectors”? | Globe versus Carousel | Geometry decides. If the cited point falls inside a polygon → “coincides with” badge. If it is a region → its own ◆. The phrase “contains N sectors” is only shown if a point-in-polygon test supports it. |
| 17 | AI contract: validate `numbers_cited[]` or use markers. There were also two sets of phases | Metrics and Loading versus AI | Markers (§5). Two separate calls. The visible phases are defined by the client state machine. |
| 18 | Offline: composer disabled or demo mode? | Loading and Layout versus Bar | “DEMO · no AI” mode active, with highlighted matches. CLAUDE.md requires this: the core flow does not depend on external APIs. |
| 19 | Five different ways of passing margins to the stage (`rightInset`, `--stage-inset-*`, `--rail-h`, `useStageInsets`, `padding-left`) | Globe, Layout, Carousel, Tesla, AI | A single `stageLayout` store (§2.1), applied when the layout settles. |
| 20 | Focus color: #FF9A7C, “#fff” or #3FB4EC | Globe, Layout, rest | The real token of `styles.css` is kept: `outline: 2px solid var(--blue-bright); outline-offset: 3px`. Inside containers with overflow, offset −2 px. |
| 21 | Bar and Tesla ask to pause auto-rotation | Bar, Tesla | There is no perpetual rotation, so those dependencies are removed. |
| 22 | ASCII sketches with invented figures: “4,1° vs 3,8° · 92 %” (Layout), “2,1° · 81 %” (Carousel) and Yungay confidence “77,4” | Layout, Carousel | Real data is used: 3,2° vs 2,2° · 69 %, and Yungay's confidence (77,45) is shown as 77,5. In addition, `formatScore` uses `maximumFractionDigits: 1`, so María Elena (49,99) currently appears as “50”. `minimumFractionDigits: 1` must be added to the place similarity. |
| 23 | Width of the right rail | Metrics, Layout, AI | `clamp(340px, 26vw, 380px)`. “View full detail sheet” expands it to 520 px with tabs: Metrics · AI Reading · Signal · Method · Sources. |
| 24 | Each component brought its own `aria-live` region | All | A single global `role=status` region with a 300–600 ms debounce, plus `role=alert` for errors. Exception: the metrics carousel on mobile, as the APG pattern indicates. |
| 25 | Is there a selected place on entry? | Carousel, Layout, current app | No. Explore starts with no selection: the globe is the protagonist and the rail stays closed. |

## 2. Single system

### 2.1 Space, breakpoints and shared state

| Range | Left | Center | Right | Bottom |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ≥1440 | “Mission” panel of 360 px (Your mission + AI Reading). In Explore only the “✦ Reading” pill is shown. | Globe + Tesla lines | Metrics rail, only with a selected place | Dock between the two panels |
| 1100–1439 | No panel; Your mission is a composer popover | Globe + lines | Rail with tabs «Metrics \| AI Reading» | Dock |
| <1100 | — | Globe in the free area | — | S0/S1/S2 sheet (between 760 and 1099 px, maximum 720 px wide and centered). In landscape with height ≤500 px, side sheet of 360 px. |

- The side panels take up the full height and the dock lives between them.
- With height <860 px: cards of 112 px, rows of 44 px and 3 Tesla labels.

**External store** (`useSyncExternalStore`), outside the R3F tree so the globe is not re-rendered:

```ts
type UiState = {
  mode: 'explorar' | 'mision'
  selection: { siteId: string; kind: 'evaluated' | 'reference'; preview: boolean } | null
  hoverSiteId: string | null                  // lightweight channel carousel → balloon
  activeCriterionId: string | null            // rail ↔ lines ↔ AI cards
  previewCriterionId: string | null
  stageInsets: { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number } // solo al asentarse
  obstacles: readonly DOMRectReadOnly[]       // rects cached with ResizeObserver, for layoutLeaders
  missionPhase: 'idle'|'interpreting'|'profile'|'scoring'|'analysis'|'done'|'error'|'cancelled'
  introPhase: 'pending' | 'play' | 'done'
  cameraTouchedAt: number | null              // decides whether results may fly to #1
}
// stageAnchor {x, y, visible, mode} cambia en cada cuadro: se escribe por ref o variable CSS, no en el store.
```

`MapStage` goes from `rightInset` to `insets {right, bottom}`. The globe applies `setViewOffset` on x and y, and MapLibre applies `setPadding`. Both are updated in `transitionend`, never on every frame.

### 2.2 Motion: tokens and rules

```css
:root {
  --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(.2, 0, 0, 1);    /* state, hover, tabs, dimming */
  --ease-enter:    cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);  /* UI entrances (the existing riseIn) */
  --ease-emph:     cubic-bezier(.05, .7, .1, 1); /* main entrances: boot, landing, leaders */
  --ease-exit:     cubic-bezier(.4, 0, 1, 1);    /* exits */
  --ease-sheet:    cubic-bezier(.32, .72, 0, 1); /* sheet, profile 380→520, popovers */
  --ease-spring:   cubic-bezier(.3, 1.4, .5, 1); /* selection pop only (existing liquid effect) */
  /* camera (in JS): easeInOutCubic ≡ cubic-bezier(.65, 0, .35, 1) */
  --dur-1: 120ms; /* micro: hover, press */
  --dur-2: 200ms; /* state: fades, chips, collapses, mode thumb */
  --dur-3: 280ms; /* panels, cards, accordion, mode switch */
  --dur-4: 400ms; /* sheet, dock, FLIP, selection pop */
  --dur-5: 700ms; /* choreography: orbit wave, complete leaders */
  --dur-6: 900ms; /* reveal: halo, similarity ring, atmosphere */
  --stagger-list: 50ms;  /* lists of at most 7 items */
  --stagger-rank: 120ms; /* landing 1→2→3: allows reading the order */
  --loop-orbit: 2400ms;  /* at most 2 revolutions */
  --o-busy: .45;
  --o-dim: .5;
}
```

**Rules:**

1. Only `transform` and `opacity` are animated. In small SVGs, also `stroke-dashoffset` and `clip-path`. Never `filter`, `blur`, `box-shadow`, `width` or `height`. Exception: `grid-template-rows` in accordions inside `contain: layout paint`.
2. No loop lasts longer than 4,8 s. After that, a static state with text remains (phase and elapsed time).
3. No figure is animated: it appears directly with its final value.
4. **Camera:**
   - Duration = `clamp(650 + 7·Δθ° + 250·|log2(h1/h0)|, 650, 1800)` ms.
   - Altitude arc if Δθ > 25°.
   - Any user input cancels it.
   - During the flight, `ZoomWatcher` and `onApproach` are suspended.
5. Direct manipulation (sheet, rotation, line tracking) has no transition.
6. Only one heartbeat at a time. While waiting for the AI, only the orbit, the composer light and a text shimmer of at most 3 passes move.
7. `prefers-reduced-motion` (in CSS and with `matchMedia` + listener):
   - no translate, scale or rotate;
   - opacity in ≤150 ms or an instant change;
   - camera as a cut;
   - no loops, halos, pulses or progressive strokes.
8. `will-change` only for the duration of each animation. Everything is paused with `document.hidden`.

### 2.3 Choreographies

**A · Startup.** Completes once per session; `?intro=full` forces it in order to record the video.

| Moment | What happens | Duration / curve |
|---|---|---|
| t = 0 (HTML only) | The orbital ring appears around the poster (desktop) or the CSS silhouette (mobile). The satellite rotates. The log shows its 3 lines. | 600 ms emph; satellite 2400 ms linear ×2 |
| Validated snapshot | The log marks ✓. The dock rises, the cards enter and the similarity rings are drawn. | Dock 400 enter; staggered 50 ms (max. 6); rings 900 ms |
| `onReady` of the globe (`intro: play`) | The ring makes a wave (scale 1→1,06 and fades out). The atmosphere glows 0,6→1,0→0,6 with bounded `invalidate`. Fade from the poster to the 3D (450 ms, already exists). | 700 emph / 900 |
| +150 ms | The outline of Chile is traced | 900 ms standard |
| +300 ms | The ● land in the order 1→2→3, each with a zone halo. Then the ◆ appear, without halo. | 320 ms emph, staggered 120 ms; halo 900 ms |
| ~1,6 s or first interaction | The log collapses into the chip «● Snapshot v2 · 3 evaluated · 8 to be calculated» | 280 ms standard |

- The camera does not move: this respects the pixel-perfect poster.
- Any pointerdown, wheel or key skips to the final state.
- If everything loads from cache in <300 ms: no orbit or log, only the landing.

**B · Manual selection of a place.**
- At 0 ms: card pop (400 ms spring) and the rail opens with the data (280 ms enter, rows every 50 ms).
- In parallel the camera flies.
- On arrival: the place ring appears (200 ms) with a pulse (900 ms), then the lines are traced (360 ms emph, every 50 ms) and the labels enter (220 ms).
- The other places drop to `--o-dim`.

**C · Waiting for the AI.**
- 0–300 ms: nothing, to avoid flicker. Only the button changes from Send to Stop (150 ms).
- From 300 ms: the orbit (only if the global view is on screen) and the composer edge light, both of 2400 ms ×2 and in phase.
- Status line with the actual phase. Previous results remain at `--o-busy` with `aria-busy`.
- 3 s: the counter appears.
- 10 s: «It's taking longer than usual» with [Cancel] and [Use base profile].
- 20 s: timed out with [Retry].

**D · Results.** The data appears first; the decorative animation follows it.

| Order | What | When |
|---|---|---|
| 1 · Globe | The orbit closes. Halos in the new order (every 120 ms). #1 stays in preview. Flight to #1 only if `cameraTouchedAt` is null. | T0 (650–1100 ms flight) |
| Data | The carousel reorders with FLIP and redraws the rings. The % appears already final. | T0 (400 / 700 ms) |
| 2 · Lines | Ring, pulse, lines and labels | When the camera arrives (≤700 ms) |
| 3 · Rail | Metrics of #1 and fact layer of the Reading | When the lines finish |
| 4 · AI Analysis | Each validated block enters with 240 ms, every 50 ms, with a queue of at most 6. When finished, a pulse of the ✦. | When lktron responds |

If there is no flight (the user moved the camera, or there is reduced motion), everything appears at T0 by opacity only. There is a single announcement: «3 places ranked for your mission. First: ‹name›, ‹%› similarity».

**E · Mode change.**
- The CSS thumb slides in 200 ms.
- The dock content exits in 120 ms and the new content enters in 200 ms, 60 ms later.
- The stage is never remounted.

### 2.4 Color, glyphs, lines, typography and glass

| Role | Value | Use | Prohibited |
|---|---|---|---|
| Earth / sector / similarity | `--blue #0297DE`, `--blue-bright #3FB4EC` | sector values, similarity rings, Tesla lines, focus | — |
| Mars (Jezero, MOLA) | `--orange #FC734D` (strokes), `--orange-bright #FF9A7C` (text) | the Martian value; logo accent | selection, error, alert |
| Confidence | `--ice #CFE9F7` | confidence bar | — |
| Selection | ring `#EAF4FA` + `--blue-line` + top accent of 2 px + "◉ on the globe" | the chosen place | orange |
| Pending / no data | `--muted-2 #6F889A`, dashed stroke | to be calculated, no data, approximate area | filler numbers |
| Error | `--text` + ✕ + border `--muted`, `role=alert` | — | red or orange |
| AI | ✦ + label "AI interpretation" + side rule of 2 px `--ice` at 50 % | generated text | appearing next to a % as if the AI had calculated it |

**Glyphs:**

| Glyph | Meaning |
|---|---|
| ● | evaluated place / sector value |
| ◆ | emblematic analog, to be calculated |
| ○ | insufficient data |
| ■ | Jezero |
| ┆ | profile rule |
| ✦ | AI only |
| ◉ | on the globe |
| ⬡ | sector (area, not pin) |
| ↗ / ↘ | more / less demanding than Jezero |
| ↑ / ↓ | weight change |
| ✓ / ✕ | milestone met / failed |

**Lines.** Solid = data. Dashed = no data, to be calculated or approximate area, across the whole site. The current ranking labels, which use a dashed line, become solid.

**Typography.**
- Current family, plus `var(--mono)` for the logbook and figure cards.
- Scale: 10 (minimum on desktop; 11 on mobile), 11 in small caps +0,08em, 12, 13, 15 (body), 18 (metric value), 23 (place %).
- All figures with `tabular-nums` and es-CL format.
- Place similarity with 1 fixed decimal. Criterion similarity as an integer; the exact value only in "Method".
- Texts of 8–9 px are removed (`.globe-label`, `.sb-note`, `.marker-score`).

**Glass.**
- Desktop: at most 3 surfaces with `backdrop-filter` (left panel, rail, dock).
- Mobile: only 1 (the sheet), with blur ≤12 px and tint ≥ .86. `data-lowfx` switches it to a solid tint.
- Markers, labels, cards and chips: `rgba(2,7,10,.84–.92)` background without blur.
- No `url(#lg-refract)` over the stage. The top bar uses a tint without blur.

## 3. Final decision per component

### 3.1 Globe and Explore: option A (single marker layer on R3F, with handoff to MapLibre)

**What is built:**
- A marker layer that is projected in `useFrame` with frameloop `demand`.
- Continuous visibility according to orientation (`smoothstep(.05, .25)`).
- Clustering when markers are less than 36 px apart: a chip with counts by type, never averages.
- Label budget and published `stageAnchor` for the lines.
- In 2D, native clustering (`cluster:true`) with the same marker style.
- Flight with an altitude arc.
- Keyboard: arrows 10°, Shift 30°, + / −, Home. Buttons + − ⌂ and double click.

**Adjustments:**
- Atmosphere brightness 0,6→1→0,6 (and not 0→0,6, so as not to jump from the poster).
- Selection in ice and blue.
- One pulse on selection, not three.
- Hover from the carousel = scale, not pulse.
- Ranking labels with a solid line.

**Discarded:** cobe, react-globe.gl and the perpetual spin.

**21st:** [cobe-globe](https://21st.dev/@shuding/components/cobe-globe.md) · [cobe-globe-pulse](https://21st.dev/@shuding/components/cobe-globe-pulse.md) · [cobe-globe-interactive](https://21st.dev/@shuding/components/cobe-globe-interactive.md) · [interactive-globe-explorer](https://21st.dev/@support_596fe4b8/components/interactive-globe-explorer.md) · [flag-globe](https://21st.dev/@dhxwhy/components/flag-globe.md) · [mapcn-marker-label](https://21st.dev/@mapcn/components/mapcn-marker-label.md) · [3d-globe](https://21st.dev/@manuarora700/components/3d-globe.md)

### 3.2 Mission bar: option A (dock with a structured, editable profile)

> **After ADR-013.** The dock is a layer over the team's planner: "Send" opens "Your mission" at
> the requirements step with the brief loaded (up to 3000 characters) and **does not call the AI**. "Your mission"
> mounts `RequirementEditor`, `ScopePicker`, `ConfirmSummary` and the team's compact `ResultView`. The
> "Refine" chips are "Use example", "Add requirement: slope / roughness / relief / bare
> soil / area / country" (without a value) and "Evaluate a sector…". The wait only exists with "Propose
> requirements with AI": orbit, counter at 3 s, notice at 10 s and "Cancel" (client cutoff at
> 45 s). What follows describes the previous version with levels and weights, now superseded.

**What is built:**
- It is the bottom row of the dock.
- **In Explore:** a pill "✦ Describe the work you want to test for Mars…", which also opens with the "/" key.
- **In Mission:**
  - textarea of 1 to 4 lines;
  - recents (⟲);
  - Send/Stop button;
  - pill with the active profile.
- **"Your mission":**
  - Placement depends on the breakpoint: panel from 1440 px, popover between 1100 and 1439 px, S2 section on mobile.
  - Four levels per criterion: Key 3 / Important 2 / Minor 1 / Exclude 0. The weight is level ÷ sum of levels.
  - Undo button.

**Adjustments:**
- Error in a neutral tone.
- The edge light makes at most 2 turns, in phase with the orbit.
- The "Refine" chips appear when the composer is focused or in the panel; the dock does not grow.
- "Why this order?" opens the Reading.
- Without a network, "DEMO · no AI" mode.

**If ADR-009: is not approved:** only precomputed profiles, and weight editing is disabled with "to be calculated".

**21st:** [ai-input-with-suggestions](https://21st.dev/@kokonutd/components/ai-input-with-suggestions.md) · [ai-input-with-loading](https://21st.dev/@kokonutd/components/ai-input-with-loading.md) · [ai-composer](https://21st.dev/@aakashmehra/components/ai-composer.md) · [prompt-suggestion](https://21st.dev/@ibelick/components/prompt-suggestion.md) · [plan](https://21st.dev/@aadixc0de/components/plan.md) · [prompt-composer](https://21st.dev/@cult-ui/components/prompt-composer.md) (border only) · [agent-chat/error](https://21st.dev/@serafimcloud/components/agent-chat/error.md)

### 3.3 Loading WOW: option B, "Honest orbit"

**What gets built:**
- **Startup.** The `loadingHints` plugin paints the ring, the satellite and the log of real milestones into the HTML. Then there is a reveal of ~1,6 s.
- **AI wait.** The same orbit returns, together with the composer light, the real phases, the counter and the cancel option.

**What is incorporated from other proposals:**
- the outline of Chile;
- the unified landing with the Globe;
- the carousel that enters as soon as the snapshot is validated;
- the `?intro=full` parameter for recording the video.

**Discarded:** radar, preloader curtain and particle orb.

**21st:** [satellite-ring](https://21st.dev/@loading-ui/components/satellite-ring.md) · [logo-trace-loader](https://21st.dev/@dqnamo/components/logo-trace-loader.md) · [staged-progress-bar](https://21st.dev/@dhxwhy/components/staged-progress-bar.md) · [loading-state](https://21st.dev/@theshanelevine/components/loading-state.md) · [busy](https://21st.dev/@zweiundeins/components/busy/skeleton-lines.md) (300 ms delay / 600 ms minimum) · [gradient-shimmer](https://21st.dev/@zanwei/components/gradient-shimmer.md) (≤3 passes) · [cobe-globe-pulse](https://21st.dev/@shuding/components/cobe-globe-pulse.md)

### 3.4 Tesla-style metric lines: option B (screen-space layer); on mobile, a single line

**Pure functions:**
- `pickPrincipalMetrics`: the 4 highest-weighted metrics; ties are resolved by canonical order.
- `layoutLeaders`:
  - label column with no crossings and inside the safe area;
  - degrades from 4 to 3, 2 and 0 labels; with 0 it shows the chip "Metrics in the panel →";
  - hysteresis so the column does not jump sides;
  - docked mode without lines when the polygon takes up more than 45 % of the width.

**Visual honesty:**
- All the lines start from a single point on the ring's edge.
- Header: "Whole sector · ≈450 km² · medians ~470 m · vs Jezero (MOLA)".

**Adjustments:**
- The side is chosen according to the free space.
- Jezero with ■.
- Curve `--ease-emph`.
- % as an integer.
- No blur.
- "Lines" toggle next to the controls.
- For exposed soil, aridity and thermal range: "Mars: no comparable measurement" or "┆ rule".

### 3.5 Places carousel: option A (native scroll-snap, several cards visible)

**Structure:**
- A horizontal `listbox` with roving tabindex.
- Two groups: "Evaluated sectors" and "◆ Emblematic · to be calculated". The emblematic ones are in alphabetical order, with no ring or ranking.
- Counter "1–4 of 11" and arrows outside the cards.
- "View list": on mobile it changes the contents of the sheet.
- `scrollToId` so that the globe takes the carousel to the chosen card.

**Card:**
- similarity ring with the word "similarity" always visible;
- separate confidence bar;
- feasibility chip;
- area "⬡ ≈ 450 km²";
- profile label next to the %.

**Adjustments:**
- While waiting for the AI, the cards are dimmed and there is no animated skeleton.
- On mobile, swipe only selects with touch input (`pointerType` touch).

### 3.6 Metrics rail: option A (accordion-carousel on desktop; tabs + swipeable track on mobile)

**`buildMetricViews` (pure function, with Vitest):**
- Ordered by the weight of the active profile.
- The Jezero value (■) exists only for slope, roughness and relief.
- For criteria of type `bounded_preference` it shows "┆ Profile rule", with a consistency check.
- The limiting factor comes from the `contribution` field.
- Badges "saturates" and "meets the rule · does not mean equal to Mars".
- Notice when two sectors share a regional value: Domeyko and María Elena have the same aridity (14,61 mm/year, same POWER source).

**Adjustments:**
- The rail appears from 1100 px and opens instantly with a manual selection.
- Figures are not interpolated.
- On mobile, the header is "‹ ● place · % ›".
- The "✦ Reading for your mission" space on each card shows the first `insight` of that criterion.

### 3.7 AI analysis: option B ("Facts first + cited text"), with option C as a secondary surface

> **After ADR-013.** The Reading has three separate layers: **result** (`MissionEvaluation`, "Deterministic
> calculation · mission-rules-1.0.0 rules · v3 similarity without recalculation"), **highlighted reasons**
> (deterministic template without ✦; with "✦ Highlight reasons with AI", the Anthropic selection validated by
> the reducer) and **snapshot facts** (direction relative to Jezero, limiting factor, saturates, shared value,
> best of N without the REF, robustness of `analysis-summary.json`). In Explore it is "Deterministic reading", without
> AI. There are no automatic calls, `{{id}}` tokens or pre-generated text.

**How it works.** A layer of facts, deterministic and network-free, appears first and instantly. On top of it comes the AI text, with chips whose figures are resolved by the UI.

**What it provides:**
- **Direction relative to Jezero:**
  - Yungay is more demanding: 1,4× in slope, 1,5× in roughness and 1,6× in relief.
  - Domeyko is around 0,6–0,7×.
  - María Elena is around 0,35×, almost flat.
- **What does not distinguish between places:**
  - thermal range: 100 % in all three;
  - exposed soil: ≈100 % in all three;
  - aridity: value shared between Domeyko and María Elena.
- **More content:** limiting factor, robustness of the ranking and coverage (90 % of the weight, because geology is yet to be calculated).
- **Recommendations and scope:** suggested test, trade-offs between places, prioritized checklist and "We do not measure this".

**Adjustments:**
- `limiting_factor` replaces `weakest_in_site`.
- On mobile it is a section of S2.
- The loading skeleton is static.
- The interpretation of the mission lives in "Your mission" and is not repeated here.

**21st:** [source-citation-rail](https://21st.dev/@rmahammad/components/source-citation-rail.md) · [ai-citations](https://21st.dev/@kokonutd/components/ai-citations.md) (toggletip, not hover only) · [cited-answer](https://21st.dev/@ham7a311/components/cited-answer.md) · [research-report](https://21st.dev/@aadixc0de/components/research-report.md) · [ai-response](https://21st.dev/@educalvolpz/components/ai-response.md) (per block) · [ai-reasoning-block](https://21st.dev/@laziekiki/components/ai-reasoning-block.md) · [text-shimmer](https://21st.dev/@serafimcloud/components/text-shimmer.md) · [motion-accordion](https://21st.dev/@motiondotdev/components/motion-accordion.md) (rebuilt in CSS)

### 3.8 Layout and navigation: option A (fixed stage + sheet with 3 detents)

**Sheet:**
- Pure function `resolveDetent(y, vy, detents)`.
- It is dragged only from the handle or the header.
- The handle is a `<button>`: a tap or the arrow keys change detent.
- S2 uses `pushState`; Back and Esc return to S1.
- `inert` on whatever falls out of view at each detent.
- Virtual keyboard with VisualViewport and `--kb-inset`, without `interactive-widget`.

**Modes:**
- Explore | Mission are tabs following the APG pattern, with a CSS thumb. In the new shell, the WebGL shader of `LiquidNav` is removed.
- `?modo=` is written with `replaceState`.
- A dot on "Mission" signals new results.

**Current sections.** Signal, Compare and Method become tabs of the full sheet (S2 on mobile, 520 px rail on desktop).

**"Go to the Reading" (M11).** The compact result of "Your mission" carries the action "Go to the Reading" (also without prioritized areas). It is a single action, next to the initial summary: after the main sentence and before the chips and groups, with a 44 px touch target (rounds 2). `uiActions.requestReading()` pins Mission and increments `ui.readingRequest`; the shell chooses the surface with the pure function `shell/readingRoute.ts`:
- ≥1440: focuses the Reading of the left panel.
- 1100–1439: opens the Reading pill, which in Mission is shown with the label "Reading". The rail and the selection do not change.
- <1100 with a ● from the snapshot: S2 on the "Reading" tab of its sheet.
- <1100 with no selection or with a ◆: S2 with the "Reading" view (slot `sheet.reading`). Back, Esc, "← Back" and ✕ return to S0 (no selection) or to S1, without clearing the selection.

Before navigating, open popovers are closed. Focus goes to the Reading title with a bounded retry (2,5 s) that is cancelled if the user presses a key or touches the screen. There is no new focus trap. Navigating does not change the selection, brief, requirements, scope or ranking, and does not call the AI.

**Printing (M11).** In `@media print` the fixed stage returns to normal flow (`html`/`body`/`#root`/`.app` without fixed height or `overflow`), and only `.mission-print` is visible. Long sections break across pages, tables repeat their header and links print their URL. Without a current report (initial load, edited test or report still on its way) a notice is printed. "Print report" stays disabled with "Preparing report…" until the report of the current evaluation (`planner.result`, sole source) is mounted; the click prints immediately, with no deferred printing.

**21st:** [drawer/snap-points](https://21st.dev/@coss.com/components/drawer/snap-points.md) · [beui-bottom-sheet](https://21st.dev/@starc007/components/beui-bottom-sheet.md) · [bottom-sheet](https://21st.dev/@f0rextasy/components/bottom-sheet.md) · [segmented-control](https://21st.dev/@halaska-studio/components/segmented-control.md) · [glass-tabs](https://21st.dev/@deepraj21/components/glass-tabs.md) · [tabbar-v2](https://21st.dev/@f0rextasy/components/tabbar-v2.md) · [prompt-input-dynamic-grow](https://21st.dev/@zochory/components/prompt-input-dynamic-grow.md)

## 4. Final screens

In the Mission screens, the % values appear as `nn,n` because the engine calculates them with the mission profile. The order and the limiting factor in the example are also set by the engine. The per-criterion figures do not depend on the profile and are real.

- The stage stays `inert` and paused.

## 5. AI contract for lktron and split between engine and AI

> **Superseded (ADR-012 → ADR-009 §7–9, integration ADR-013).** The contracts in this section
> (`mission-interpretation/1`, `evidence-packet/1`, `ai-analysis/1`) and the lktron channel were retired.
> The current contract is the team's `contracts/mission-ai.schema.json`, with `server/ai` (Anthropic,
> key only on the server) and `apps/web/src/mission/aiClient.ts`: the AI proposes requirements without
> confirming them or chooses IDs from an evaluation that has already been computed; the client accepts the selection only if the
> fingerprints match and `checkSelection` passes. The text is kept as a record.

### 5.1 Flow

1. **Interpret.** `POST /interpret` → `mission-interpretation/1`, a single JSON object.
2. **Compute on the client:**
   - validates with precompiled Ajv;
   - normalizes the weights;
   - recomputes with the TypeScript engine (ADR-009) and sorts;
   - builds `evidence-packet/1`.
3. **Analyze.** `POST /analyze` → `ai-analysis/1` in NDJSON, one complete object per line.

**Visible phases.** They are defined by the client's state machine (`domain/missionPhase.ts`):
- interpreting (lktron)
- profile (the client validates)
- scoring (engine, no AI)
- analysis (lktron)
- and as the end: done, error or cancelled.

**No network or no endpoint:**
- Step 1 is resolved by keywords («DEMO · no AI»), with the matches highlighted.
- Step 3 uses `artifacts/science-v2/ai-analysis.default.json` if its fingerprint matches. If it does not match, only the facts are shown.

### 5.2 `mission-interpretation/1` (lktron → client)

```json
{
  "schema": "mission-interpretation/1",
  "engine": "lktron", "model": "<id>", "prompt_version": "<semver>",
  "base_profile": { "id": "mars-rover-screening-v2", "version": "<profile version>" },
  "status": "ok",
  "mission_summary": "Autonomous rover navigation test on rocky terrain",
  "criteria": [
    { "id": "slope",                           "level": 3, "rationale": "text without figures" },
    { "id": "terrain_roughness",               "level": 3, "rationale": "…" },
    { "id": "local_relief",                    "level": 2, "rationale": "…" },
    { "id": "bare_ground_fraction",            "level": 2, "rationale": "…" },
    { "id": "aridity_context",                 "level": 1, "rationale": "…" },
    { "id": "surface_temperature_variability", "level": 0, "rationale": "…" }
  ],
  "assumptions": ["text without figures"],
  "unsupported": [{ "phrase": "wheel-scale obstacles", "reason": "not_measured" }]
}
```

**Validation rules:**
- `status` is `ok` or `no_terrain_criteria`.
- Each `id` belongs to the 7 criteria of the base profile and is not repeated.
- Missing criteria have level 0 and are shown as «not mentioned», editable.
- `level` ∈ {0, 1, 2, 3}.
- `geologic_relevance` can be requested, but remains «to be computed» and reduces coverage. If coverage falls below 0,70 (`minimum_valid_weight`), «Insufficient data for this profile» is shown instead of the %.
- No text contains digits or written-out numbers, and each has at most 280 characters.
- `additionalProperties: false`: the schema has nowhere to put a %, a confidence or a ranking.

**Request** (`mission-interpret-request/1`): `{ text, locale: "es-CL", catalog: [{ id, label, has_data, status }], base_profile_id, current_profile | null }`. `current_profile` is used when refining.

### 5.3 `evidence-packet/1` (client → lktron)

It is the only source the AI may cite.

```json
{
  "schema": "evidence-packet/1",
  "packet_hash": "fnv1a64:…",
  "snapshot": "science-screening-v2",
  "profile": { "id": "mission:<hash>", "origin": "mission", "status": "needs_calibration",
               "weights": { "slope": 0.27, "terrain_roughness": 0.27, "local_relief": 0.18 } },
  "mission_summary": "…",
  "sites": ["cl-pampa-yungay-screening", "cl-domeyko-interior-screening", "cl-pampa-maria-elena-screening"],
  "facts": {
    "site:cl-pampa-yungay-screening:slope:raw": "3,2°",
    "site:cl-pampa-yungay-screening:slope:sim": "69 %",
    "site:cl-pampa-yungay-screening:slope:ratio": "1,4× Jezero",
    "site:cl-pampa-yungay-screening:slope:vs_mars": "steeper than Jezero",
    "mars:slope": "2,2°",
    "site:cl-pampa-yungay-screening:similarity": "‹engine›",
    "site:cl-pampa-yungay-screening:confidence": "‹engine›",
    "coverage:cl-pampa-yungay-screening": "90% of the weight",
    "rank:gap:1:2": "‹engine›",
    "sens:flips": "‹engine›"
  },
  "fact_kinds": [
    { "kind": "limiting_factor", "site_id": "cl-pampa-yungay-screening", "criterion_id": "terrain_roughness" },
    { "kind": "no_discrimination", "criterion_id": "surface_temperature_variability" },
    { "kind": "shared_regional_value", "criterion_id": "aridity_context",
      "site_ids": ["cl-domeyko-interior-screening", "cl-pampa-maria-elena-screening"] },
    { "kind": "direction_vs_mars", "site_id": "cl-pampa-yungay-screening", "criterion_id": "slope", "direction": "more_demanding" },
    { "kind": "best_of_n", "site_id": "…", "criterion_id": "…" },
    { "kind": "saturates_rule", "site_id": "…", "criterion_id": "surface_temperature_variability" }
  ],
  "checks": { "check:cl-pampa-yungay-screening:1": "‹snapshot field_check›" },
  "unsupported": [{ "phrase": "…", "reason": "not_measured" }]
}
```

The fingerprint is computed with 64-bit FNV-1a in pure JS, because `crypto.subtle` may not be available when the ZIP is opened from `file://`.

### 5.4 `ai-analysis/1` (lktron → client, NDJSON)

```text
{"type":"meta","schema":"ai-analysis/1","engine":"lktron","model":"…","prompt_version":"…","packet_hash":"…"}
{"type":"stage","stage":"selecting_facts"|"writing"}
{"type":"summary","site_id":"…"|null,"text":"… {{site:…:slope:ratio}} …","refs":["…"]}
{"type":"insight","id":"i1","site_id":"…","criterion_id":"terrain_roughness","fact_kind":"limiting_factor","text":"…","refs":["…"]}
{"type":"test_suggestion","site_id":"…","text":"…","refs":["…"]}
{"type":"tradeoff","site_ids":["…","…"],"text":"…","refs":["…"]}
{"type":"robustness_note","text":"…","refs":["sens:flips","rank:gap:1:2"]}
{"type":"uncertainty","text":"…","refs":["…"],"resolves_check":"check:…"}
{"type":"field_priority","site_id":"…","check_ref":"check:…:1","why":"…","refs":["…"]}
{"type":"analog_note","analog_id":"devon-island","status":"por_calcular","text":"…"}
{"type":"done","counts":{"insight":5,"tradeoff":1}}
{"type":"error","code":"timeout"|"invalid"|"unavailable","message":"…"}
```

Caps: 6 `insight` per place, 4 `tradeoff` and 280 characters per text.

**Where each event is shown:**

| Event | Place in the UI |
|---|---|
| `summary` | panel verdict, pill and ✦ line of S1 |
| `insight` | finding card; in addition, the first one for each criterion goes to "✦ Reading for your mission" in the rail |
| `tradeoff` | "Comparison" tab |
| `robustness_note` | below the robustness bars (which are deterministic) |
| `uncertainty` | uncertainty accordion, with "Resolve in the field →" |
| `field_priority` | only the order of the checklist; the items come from the snapshot |
| `test_suggestion` | "Suggested test (AI)" |
| `analog_note` | "Other analogs · to be calculated" |

### 5.5 Validation of each event before displaying it

1. Schema validated with precompiled Ajv (`scripts/build-validators.mjs`).
2. `packet_hash` equal to the current fingerprint. If it does not match, the content is marked "Outdated" and the stream is canceled with AbortController.
3. Each `{{id}}` exists in `facts` and is declared in `refs`.
4. Outside the markers there are no digits, %, or written-out numbers ("one…hundred", "half", "double", "triple", "third", "times").
5. The `fact_kind` of a `insight` matches an entry in `fact_kinds`, and the text cites its own criterion.
6. Vocabulary filter: "safe", "approved", "guarantees", "ideal", "suitable", "score" (puntaje), "score" and "the best" are rejected. Criteria that are not measured (ice, mineral, radiation, regolith, chemistry) can only appear in `unsupported`.
7. Whatever does not pass is discarded and the discard is reported: "1 sentence discarded: it cited data that does not exist". Unvalidated text is never shown.

### 5.6 Who calculates what

| Result | Calculated / written by | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Similarity per criterion (`normalized_similarity`) | Python pipeline | snapshot |
| Place similarity, base profile | Pipeline | snapshot |
| Place similarity, mission profile | TS engine, port of `aggregate()` with parity test | `domain/aggregate.ts` (ADR-009) |
| Confidence, stability, feasibility | Pipeline. With a mission profile: TS engine if ADR-009 covers it; if not, "to be calculated with your profile" | — |
| Ranking | `rankCandidates` | `domain/scoring.ts` |
| Normalized weights, coverage | Client (level ÷ sum of levels) | `domain/missionProfile.ts` |
| Direction and reason relative to Jezero; "does not distinguish"; shared regional value; "saturates / meets the rule"; the 4 main metrics | Client, by comparing values | `metricModel.ts`, `evidencePacket.ts` |
| Limiting factor | `contribution` of the pipeline (base profile) or TS engine (mission profile) | — |
| Robustness (gap 1–2, scenarios that change the order, most sensitive criterion) | `sensitivity` of the pipeline (base profile) or TS port (mission profile) | `domain/robustness.ts` |
| Criteria, levels, assumptions, what was requested without data, mission summary | AI | `mission-interpretation/1` |
| Which facts matter for the mission and why; suggested test; trade-offs between places; checklist order | AI, citing facts | `ai-analysis/1` |

## 6. Performance and dependencies

### 6.1 Budget

| Item | Limit |
|---|---|
| Main chunk | +≤12 KB gz of JS and +≤5 KB gz of CSS: shell, sheet, tabs, PlaceRail, minimal composer, store |
| Inline HTML | +≤2 KB gz: ring, silhouette and logbook |
| Deferred chunks | Globe markers +≤4 KB (in the globe chunk); lines ≤4; rail ≤10; mission ≤8 (card, history, matcher, aggregate); analysis + validators ≤10 |
| Data | `reference_analogs.json` ≤3 KB; `ai-analysis.default.json` ≤10 KB, loaded deferred |
| LCP, TBT, CLS | No regression versus 857b05f: median of 5 Lighthouse runs using the method from `docs/PERFORMANCE.md`. CLS 0 (the shell reserves the dock and the sheet). On mobile, if the logbook becomes a late LCP, it appears after 1 s and the wordmark remains as the LCP. |
| INP | <200 ms when tapping a card, switching mode, opening a row or submitting |
| Sheet drag | ≤16 ms per frame with CPU ×4 |
| WebGL | 0 draws at rest; `never` in S2 and with the tab hidden. It only draws continuously during flights (≤1,8 s), inertia, intro and the 900 ms glow. |
| Glass | ≤3 surfaces with blur on desktop and ≤1 on mobile |
| Offline | Everything works except the call to lktron |

### 6.2 Dependencies

**Approved (already installed):**
- three, @react-three/fiber and drei (OrbitControls, Line);
- maplibre-gl (`cluster:true`, Marker);
- Precompiled Ajv;
- Platform APIs: Pointer Events, VisualViewport, `inert`, ResizeObserver, IntersectionObserver, scroll-snap, Web Animations, dvh and `env(safe-area-inset-*)`.

**Rejected:**

| Package | Weight / reason |
|---|---|
| motion / framer-motion | 50,0 KB gz measured |
| Embla | 7,7 KB gz |
| vaul | 22,4 KB gz and unmaintained |
| @base-ui Drawer | 38,6 KB gz |
| cobe | second WebGL context and no real Earth |
| react-globe.gl / three-globe | duplicate three |
| supercluster (direct) | MapLibre already includes it internally |
| GSAP, @visx/annotation, Markdown parser, lucide-react, Tailwind, Radix Tabs | unnecessary; solved with CSS, SVG and custom code |
| `LiquidNav` WebGL shader in the new shell | second WebGL context |

## 7. Build order, risks and pending decisions

### 7.1 Verifiable increments

In every increment, `npm run build` and `npm run test` stay green and `project/STATUS.md` is updated.

| # | Deliverable | Done when |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | ADR-008/009/010 in proposed status. Schemas `reference_analog`, `mission-interpretation`, `evidence-packet` and `ai-analysis`, with precompiled validators | Valid and invalid fixtures behave as expected |
| 1 | Tokens from §2.2 and §2.4. Store `ui`. Hook `useReducedMotion` with listener. `formatScore` with fixed decimal 1 | Store tests; "50,0" displays correctly |
| 2 | Shell: fixed stage, mode tabs, dock, empty rail, S0/S1/S2 sheet (`resolveDetent`, `useKeyboardInset`), `insets {right, bottom}` | `resolveDetent` tests (thresholds, hysteresis, cancellation). On mobile, one finger rotates the globe without scrolling |
| 3 | PlaceRail + `config/reference_analogs.json`: only the ◆ that have a cited source | Stable order, nulls last, ◆ without %. Keyboard per APG. Globe ↔ carousel sync |
| 4 | Globe marker layer, flight, grouping, keyboard, ◆ and ○ | Tests for grouping, flight formula, `smoothstep` and point-in-polygon. 0 drawings at rest |
| 5 | MetricRail + `buildMetricViews`; S1 on mobile | Order by weight, no invented Mars data, limiting factor by `contribution`, "saturates", shared regional value |
| 6 | Tesla lines (`pickPrincipalMetrics`, `layoutLeaders`, globe/2D projector) | No crossings, inside the safe area, degradation, hysteresis, coupled mode. No per-frame `setState` |
| 7 | Startup Loading WOW (`loadingHints`, `bootMilestone`, intro). `posterLayout`, `mapZoom` and `boot.test` adjusted to the new margins | `boot.test` pixel-perfect. Lighthouse with no regression. `?intro=full` works |
| 8 | Mission engine: TS port of `aggregate` (and of `sensitivity` if feasible), predefined profiles (Mobility + partial `needs_calibration`), DEMO matcher, `missionPhase` | Parity with `pipelines/scoring.py` (tolerance ≤1e-6). Thresholds of 3, 10 and 20 s. Cancel and replace |
| 9 | Composer, "Your mission" (levels, Undo, history) and results choreography | Mission → results with no network in DEMO mode. The engine sets the order. A single announcement |
| 10 | `evidencePacket`, `analysisTokens`, `robustness`, Reading panel with facts, pregenerated analysis, lktron NDJSON client behind a flag | Adversarial filter tests (digits, "double", vocabulary). FNV fingerprint. "Outdated" state |
| 11 | QA: VoiceOver and TalkBack, keyboard, reduced motion and reduced transparency, CPU ×4, offline ZIP. `docs/`, `CHANGELOG` and `DEMO_ACCEPTANCE` | Complete checklist |

**Minimum cut if time runs short:** increments 0–7; the 8 only with predefined profiles (no weight editing); the 10 only with facts and pregenerated analysis.

### 7.2 Risks

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| ADR-009 is not approved or parity with Python fails | Profiles precomputed by the pipeline; the AI only chooses among them; weight editing disabled with "to be computed" |
| lktron does not deliver structured output or NDJSON | "Facts only" mode + DEMO matcher; unvalidated text is never shown |
| `backdrop-filter` over WebGL on mid-range devices | ≤1 blur on mobile; `data-lowfx` with solid tint if dragging exceeds 16 ms with CPU ×4 |
| Custom sheet gestures on iOS (pointercancel, scrollend in Safari) | Dragging only from the handle; every detent reachable with buttons; `resolveDetent` tests; QA on a real device |
| Mobile LCP worsens because of the log | Fixed-size log, visible from the HTML; if it worsens, it appears after 1 s |
| Poster misaligned by the new margins | `boot.test` detects it to the pixel; update `posterLayout`, `mapZoom` and the test in the same commit |
| The ◆ without coordinates or source | They are not shown (data rule); the carousel keeps only the evaluated sectors |
| Saturation between 1100 and 1439 px (lines, rail and dock) | Degradation 4→3→2→0 with chip; a single side panel |
| Plausible but false AI sentence, without figures | Stance fixed by the engine, vocabulary filter, fixed label, one-click checklist. The residual risk is acknowledged in the UI |
| Unvalidated Tesla choreography (tesla.com returned 403) | Validate it with a user screenshot before increment 6 |

### 7.3 Decisions the team needs to make

1. **Data for the 8 ◆.** Who provides them and how? Each one needs a coordinate or region and a cited source. In particular, is "Atacama" a point in the Yungay area or the entire desert?
2. **lktron:** will it have structured output (JSON Schema), per-object NDJSON and AbortController support? Where does it run and how is the endpoint configured without committing secrets to the repository?
3. **Approvals:** ADR-009 (from levels to weights and client-side recalculation; currently superseded ADR-015,) by the science team, and ADR-010 (currently superseded ADR-012,; exception to "no LLM in the core demo": only as an optional enhancement, with the pregenerated analysis labeled as non-scientific).
4. **Current sections:** is moving Signal, Compare and Method to tabs of the detail card acceptable? It is the recommendation.
5. **Jezero thermal range:** incorporate a Martian measurement (MEDA) via ADR and a cited source, or keep "┆ Profile rule"?
6. **Reference device:** which mid-range Android will be used to finalize the blur and tint values?

Files of the ASCII sketches (intermediate work only, outside the repository): /tmp/analogos_ascii/all.txt
